component_conditions.inspection_notes: Notes: DIRT/GREASE Guideline: Transmission: Fluid slightly discolored. A few areas of seepage. Engine: Few small leaks. Belts and hoses firm, show minimal wear. Significant dirt and grease in engine compartment.

Notes: Passenger Tires: Rt Frt Tire-4/32; Lt Frt Tire-4/32; Rt Rr Tire-1/32; Lt Rr Tire-2/32. % of Tread Wear-0.25. Condition Rating-Rough. Guideline: Rear Tires: 40% or less of new. Example: Typical new car tires are 11/32, loss measures at 3/32 = 28% (3/11) Front Tires: 40% or less of new. Example: Typical new car tires are 11/32, loss measures at 3/32 = 28% (3/11)

Notes: PAINT ON RT QTR HEAVILY FADED, SCRATCHES ON TRUNK, SCRATCHES REAR BUMPER, HOOD MISSING CLEAR Guideline: Numerous large deep chips and/or scratches. Heavy peeling, flaking, fading and/or mismatched panels. Significant fading.

Notes: REAR BUMPER CRACKED, DAMAGE TO RT FRONT DOOR, DENT HOOD Guideline: Sheet Metal: Few dents and/or numerous dings. No significant surface rust. Trim: Minimal damage to components. Few dents and/or numerous dings.
Notes: W/S CHIPPED Guideline: Light surface scratches and/or pitting. Few chips.
Notes: LARGE TEARS IN PASSENGER SEAT, DRIVERS SEAT HEAVILY WORN Guideline: Heavily soiled, faded and/or discolored. Numerous large tears, holes and/or burn marks. Heavily worn and bare spots.
Notes: SOILED/STAINED Guideline: Lightly soiled and/or stained. Few small tears, holes and/or burn marks. No significant bare spots.
Notes: STEERING WHEEL HEAVILY WORN Guideline: Significant scratches and/or gouges. Components damaged and/or cracked. Significant wear.
Notes: LOOSE, SCUFFED/STAINED Guideline: Numerous large holes and/or burn marks. Heavily scuffed.
